title: Constructor-local typed reference iterator for the complete1015 hour/day argument
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED. Replace1015s separately stipulated antecedent choices by one explicit typed iterator: within a complete constructor, fetch the most recent completed matching referent not already used by that constructor. C07 dy/dy then selects DAY and HOUR; C12 METHOD/METHOD selects B thenA. C11 SAME can see only completed methodA whileB remains open. This is a new limited reference grammar, not a recovered meaning or a repair to947.
fixed_model: All60 hypothesized word values, all80 supplied groups,12 original constructor boundaries, arithmetic, nonreference operands, cyclic successor, unit repetition and rival numeric settings remain unchanged. Work is over the complete model account; a manuscript-level literal claim remains barred until root resolves its diplomatic transcription/seam audit. No source reading is normalized by this proposal.
new_assumptions: A completed constructor opens a new local used-reference setU; the reset boundary is exactly the existing12-clause model boundary, not an inferred punctuation sign.

Backward antecedent choices share one most-recent-unused-by-type algorithm. Distinct ordinary METHOD operands are therefore a consequence of consuming two references in one constructor, not a bespoke second-slot previous-distinct rule.
An in-progress calculation can use its local result, but is added to the discourse method/result registry only after its whole constructor, including any equality assertion, closes.
Types, referent creation, completedness and the supplied constructor boundaries are all model assumptions. No claim that one short target form independently spells this iterator.

operation.rule: Traverse completed referents in decreasing last-mention/creation order. Select the first with required typeT whose identity is not inU. Add that identity toU. Fail when no such referent exists. The choice cannot inspect the desired equality outcome, target word, clause index or intended antecedentID.
operation.identity: A later mention of the same DAY or HOUR unit updates recency but does not manufacture a fresh referent. MethodA andMethodB are two explicitly introduced computations. The local used set blocks referent identity, not spelling; it does not delete objects from the discourse registry.
operation.publication: C10 registers methodA and its ruler-result at closure. C11 opens methodB, evaluates its own local result, resolves SAME against completed result history, checks equality, and only then registers methodB/result. C12 starts with both completed methods. No registry update is inferred solely from the desired final agreement.

known_countercases_and_ceiling: GDT1015 already supplied the desiredD/U andB/A bindings. This iterator is a post-exposure factorization of those choices, not independently learned syntax; its main result may only restate the primary model.
GDT1015 retainsSAME_METHOD_REFERENCE as a coherent rival. A success here excludes it only under the newly assumed consumption discipline, never as a manuscript reading generally.
Reflexive comparisons and repeated anaphoric references are legitimate possibilities. The no-reuse rule is a narrow candidate convention, not an argument that real language must avoid them.

GDT933 showed that typed recency can fill participants by presuming unread intervals. This proposal uses a fully assigned hypothetical account, but the guessed words/types and clause boundaries replace neither independent evidence nor source verification.

No productive subword meaning is supplied by this reference factorization. All singleton glosses, night/reversal alternatives and seven-cycle label symmetry remain.

smallest_decision_changing_test.decision: Keep the iterator only if every declared backward selection follows the single rule with no desired-ID lookup. If another choosing field or real repeated-reference requirement breaks it, close this specific reference discipline; do not add clause-specific reset or reuse exceptions. Passing provides a smaller conditional binding account, not a selected translation.
